how: The starter reports placing two pixels, gives coordinates, and asks the collective to finish the flag.
Members call others to finish a flag and restart a heart flag together.
A national flag is proposed and made in a heart as a smaller representation.
Members report the heart flag already made and needing collective maintenance.
Participants circulate coordinates for distinct flag attempts without establishing one agreed template.
A maker and a respondent describe defending the heart flag, repeated attacks, and difficulty defending alone.
A participant attributes a counter-change to Pakistan, supporting reported responsibility without verified tracing of placers.
A reply rejects mutual attacks and proposes a small adjacent flag that a later reply says will not infringe.
Participants propose a South Asia defence pact and a deal with another subreddit without recording acceptance by counterparts.
Participants report replacing a Pakistani flag and propose further conversions of Pakistani and Indian flags.
A participant reports losing the heart and proposes a smaller mark, matching the element's minimal proposal range without demonstrating completed relocation.
A respondent thanks the heart maker and says defending the flag has been fun.
The final edit reports small surviving flag fragments and closure, while a latecomer marks having missed participation.
The final retrospective wishes for better organisation and readiness to create and defend next time.
The complaint about defending alone provides evidence of strain but cannot determine whether anyone used scripts, bots, or spare accounts.
The bare reply endorses a negotiation proposal without asking for anything back.
Proposals for a pact and a deal do not establish actual inter-room assistance or an exchange of pixels.
An internal pact proposal and encouragement do not establish reciprocal commitment or a formed coalition.
Replies celebrate replacement as revenge and frame the reported counter-change as a reason to defend honour.
A flag inside a heart establishes a location without demonstrating a host's rule over guest builders.
The moderator stickies an organising thread and offers to promote a better information post, supporting a focal thread without demonstrating posting restrictions.
Requests for moderators to organise and an administrator offer do not show a dispute over who can bind the room to an inter-room agreement.
A retrospective report and a late-arrival lament do not establish disputes over cleanup, historical versions, or correction of others' accounts.
The recruitment and war passages do not identify an April Fools prank framing that makes their claims doubtful.
Space scarcity and a lost heart make a smaller mark seem more maintainable.
Revenge and destruction yet again suggest prior grievance without naming a specific quarrel predating the canvas.
Calls to show the country's impact and fight for the country express national belonging beyond an image specification.
One room cannot test the cross-room frequency claim, while its organiser requests and administrator offer cannot establish accepted command.
National revenge language does not explicitly identify the earlier historical tie claimed to select the rival.
Asking someone to negotiate does not establish that any member acted as an envoy between rooms.
The call precedes a maker's report without a statement that the call recruited that maker.
The starter's already-placed pixels become the explicit basis for asking the collective to finish the flag in the same passage.
The maker explicitly links having made the heart flag to the need for collective maintenance, later reported as active defence.
Defence strain and a proposed pact are visible without a passage linking that strain to negotiation with an eroding neighbour.
The restraint passages cite building an own flag and avoiding mutual attacks without a settled border that could test the proposed mechanism.
Defending alone documents strain without showing a subsequent turn to automated or additional accounts.
The thanks directly credits a reported heart-flag maker, supporting recognition of work already made rather than requiring a completed large design.
Credit for the heart flag and a retrospective fate report do not say that celebration caused recording or preservation.
The organiser connects a retrospective assessment of lateness to hoping for better preparation next time within one passage.
Space scarcity and the reported loss motivate a proposal for a smaller mark, without establishing an enacted move.
Coordinates and their withdrawal do not establish design debate settled by an agreed pixel template.
Bare assent answers a negotiation proposal rather than documenting an answer to a call for placers.
Difficulty defending alone and proposed cooperation do not establish that another room was asked because of that difficulty or sent help.
An unconfirmed deal title cannot establish an agreed border opening a channel for exchanges of help.
The edited opening post combines building and war calls without passage-level edit times or a statement proving that recruited builders became attackers.
The reply explicitly rejects replacing the rival flag and offers a small adjacent flag instead.
The attack proposal receives an internal restraint reply, while a separate deal proposal does not demonstrate attack-triggered negotiation with a neighbour.
The revenge reply explicitly interprets the reported flag conversion and begins the ensuing honour exchange.
Strained defence and an internally endorsed pact proposal cannot establish either coalition formation or the claimed cause of joining.
The moderator promotes organising information without saying that a flood of canvas calls caused containment.
An unconfirmed pact and an internal administrator offer do not supply a settled agreement followed by a dispute over its authority.
Alliance proposals require evidence of counterpart commitment before they can be explained as coalition formation.
Promoting an organising post establishes a public focus but does not by itself establish containment or restrictions on other canvas posts.
A moderator's support for better assets, coordinates, and goals needs an information-organising explanation unless a flood-to-containment response is evidenced.
Finding the room after placement ends must remain a temporal exclusion rather than evidence that the room lacks hands or canvas space.
Shrinkage and restart proposals cannot establish that the room stopped fighting or completed a move.
The attack caller can qualify their own call by directing members to protect their flag instead of ruining the rival's.
A replacement organising post earns the moderator's conditional promotion by keeping current assets, coordinates, and goals updated.

statement: routing organising between a public information post and live chat
how: A dedicated chat handles proposed live coordination while a requested public sticky carries the invite, information, and goals.

statement: finding the organising room after placement has ended
how: Late discovery makes participation in this room's placing effort unavailable even without a demonstrated shortage of people or space.
The moderator's offer of an updated information post receives a request to carry Discord, information, and goals in the sticky.
A respondent celebrates a reported flag conversion as glorious during the ongoing contest.
A participant answers an objection about occupied coordinates by explaining why the proposed smaller flag will not infringe on its neighbours.
